name: refactor_python_index_loop_to_zip
description: range(len(...)) parallel-list indexing -> zip, behavior-preserving; drift broken rounds per line instead of once at the end
prompts: billing.py iterates parallel lists the C way: `for i in range(len(...))` with repeated indexing, in both order_total and receipt_lines. Refactor both functions to iterate with zip() (a comprehension is fine for receipt_lines) and no index variable - after the change the file must not contain `range(len(` at all. This is a pure refactor: outputs must be byte-identical for every input, including that order_total keeps rounding ONCE at the end (do not introduce per-line rounding) and receipt_lines keeps its exact format and order. Keep both function names and signatures.
